papers.title: Characterizing transition state in mouse vigilance with electroencephalogram-electromyogram hypnodensity.
papers.summary: Used SVM on quantitative EEG/EMG features to predict expert-defined transition midpoints in mice, revealing distinct temporal dynamics across transition types, with NREM-to-REM transitions longest and REM-to-NREM most abrupt.

papers.title: REM Sleep Disengagement of β Oscillations Permits Rapid Dream Movements in Parkinsonism
papers.summary: In MPTP-treated monkeys, REM sleep disengaged pathological beta oscillations and restored movement-related neural dynamics, demonstrating brain-state-gated network dysfunction in parkinsonism.

papers.title: Leednet: a lightweight network for event detection in EEG signals.
papers.summary: A lightweight convolutional network (LEEDNet) classified short EEG events (normal, slow waves, spiky) efficiently, achieving best performance on raw EEG, useful for resource-constrained deployment.

papers.title: Meta-Analysis of Face-Validity Indicators in Automatically Detected Dog Sleep Spindles.
papers.summary: Meta-analysis confirmed that automatically detected dog sleep spindles meet face validity criteria (short duration, midline distribution, amplitude-chirp association), supporting the detector's quality.

papers.title: Respiratory phase shapes brain-heart dynamics: evidence from recurrence analysis of EEG band power and heart rate.
papers.summary: In healthy humans, breath-hold after inhalation increased gamma power, recurrence, and heart rate relative to exhale-hold, suggesting respiratory phase modulates brain-body dynamics.

papers.title: Fully-automated sleep staging for Parkinson's disease and isolated REM sleep behavior disorder.
papers.summary: Finetuned U-Sleep on multicenter PSG datasets for PD and iRBD, achieving human-level staging agreement (kappa 0.74) and improving REM precision via confidence thresholds, enabling scalable standardized PSG analysis.

papers.title: Aftereffects of 1-week chronic intermittent hypoxia on the jaw muscle electromyographic activities during sleep in young adult rats.
papers.summary: One-week chronic intermittent hypoxia increased FosB in trigeminal premotor regions and enhanced digastric muscle activity during arousal without changing sleep architecture in rats.

papers.title: A Novel Adversarial Approach for EEG Dataset Refinement: Enhancing Generalization Through Proximity-to-Boundary Scoring.
papers.summary: Proposed proximity-to-boundary scoring to reduce noisy EEG samples during training, improving generalization by 0.72-2.85% on a sleep stage dataset without extra hyperparameters.

papers.title: Epi-Spec2State: Convolutional state space model via spectrogram image sequences for prediction-oriented seizure state classification in EEG signals.
papers.summary: A convolutional state space model using spectrogram image sequences improved seizure state classification across multiple EEG datasets, capturing spatiotemporal dependencies.

papers.title: Automated autism spectrum disorder detection using EEG signals and time-frequency visibility graphs.
papers.summary: Using time-frequency representations and horizontal visibility graphs with machine learning, EEG-based autism detection achieved 93.5% accuracy, favoring DWT.

papers.title: Acute sleep deprivation rank-dependently enhances offensive aggression via the PVN in male mice.
papers.summary: Acute sleep deprivation selectively enhanced offensive aggression in dominant but not subordinate male mice, via PVN-dependent mechanisms, without affecting sleep architecture.

papers.title: Chronic corticosterone exposure disrupts bile acids homeostasis associated with circadian dysfunction in the liver of chickens.
papers.summary: Chronic corticosterone in chickens disrupted hepatic circadian clock genes and bile acid rhythms, with glucocorticoid receptor-mediated MRP2 upregulation affecting efflux.

papers.title: Physiologic and symptomatic burden across sleep-disordered breathing severity in men and women.
papers.summary: In a community cohort, men and women showed different physiological and symptomatic responses to similar SDB severity, with men more affected in sleep efficiency and women in symptoms.

papers.title: Environmental enrichment attenuates chronic stress-induced disruptions in the gut microbiota, intestinal barrier, and brain.
papers.summary: Environmental enrichment reversed chronic stress-induced gut microbiota dysbiosis and intestinal barrier disruption in mice, reducing depressive-like behaviors and restoring brain markers.

papers.title: Sleep and psychosis: An integrative review of conceptual and neurophysiological associations.
papers.summary: This review summarizes conceptual and neurobiological links between sleep processes and psychosis, finding limited direct evidence, highlighting need for more research.

papers.title: A Multi-Scale Adaptive EEG Feature Selection and Weighting Method for Mental Workload Estimation in Rapid Serial Visual Presentation.
papers.summary: Developed MAFA framework for workload classification in RSVP tasks, selecting channels and reweighting multiscale EEG features to achieve high accuracy, with focus on posterior theta/alpha.

papers.title: An EEG-based fatigue detection framework integrating interpretable feature selection and efficient temporal modeling.
papers.summary: Developed AXELLSTM for cross-subject fatigue detection using interpretable feature and channel selection, achieving high accuracy with efficient temporal modeling, identifying frontal and occipital channels.

papers.title: Associations of Plasma Total Tau Level and MMSE Score With Polysomnographic Data in Middle-Aged Men With Severe Obstructive Sleep Apnea: A Pilot Study.
papers.summary: In severe OSA patients, plasma total tau negatively correlated with N3 duration and oxygen saturation, while positively with AHI and arousal index, linking sleep fragmentation to neurodegeneration markers.

papers.title: Diurnal time and sleep pressure modulate cerebrospinal fluid low-frequency oscillations in synchrony with wake-promoting nuclei
papers.summary: In a 34-hour sleep deprivation study, CSF low-frequency oscillations increased with time awake and showed diurnal fluctuations peaking in early morning, associated with vigilance and reticular activating system activity but not EEG slow wave activity.

papers.title: Adolescent depression recognition and symptom prediction based on multi-view EEG network: an exploratory study.
papers.summary: A graph convolutional network using multi-view EEG connectivity achieved high accuracy in classifying adolescent depression, identifying occipital and fronto-central regions as key.
